alert.name: DatabaseAlarm
alert.summary: Alert fired for PostgreSQL database warden

logs: postgres stuck connection: pid=4934 idle in transaction for 360s: LOCK TABLE warden_proving_ground IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE

root_cause.hypothesis: App transaction acquired ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock on warden_proving_ground then stalled mid-transaction (idle in transaction, pid=4934, 360s), blocking 2 other queries waiting on that lock. No deploy correlates — likely app bug/missing commit-rollback or stuck client, not schema migration.
evidence: locks_waiting=2 consistent with queries blocked behind ACCESS EXCLUSIVE hold
connections_used_pct low (13.9%) — rules out connection exhaustion as root cause
RECENT DEPLOYS empty — rules out deploy-triggered migration/lock

proposal.reasoning: pid 4934 idle-in-transaction 360s holding ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock on warden_proving_ground, blocking 2 queries. proposal.expected_effect: pid 4934 terminated, txn rolled back, ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock released, 2 waiting queries unblock, locks_waiting drops to 0.
